en.title: Use Cases Are Optional: What Flutter's Official Architecture Guide Actually Recommends
en.subtitle: Flutter's guide strongly recommends two layers, views, view models and repositories. The domain layer is conditional: add a use case when the logic earns it.

ar-EG.title: الـ use cases مش إجبارية: الـ architecture اللي Flutter بينصح بيه فعلًا
ar-EG.subtitle: دليل Flutter بينصح بقوة بـ layers اتنين، وviews وview models وrepositories. أما الـ domain layer فمشروطة: ضيف use case لما الـ logic يستاهل.
